reviews.text:
I left my beloved cat with Sara for a week, and everything went great! Sara is an animal lover, empathetic, and loving with her guests! The environment is comfortable, warm, and spotlessly clean! She sends us videos and photos every day to keep us updated, which is very reassuring! I found my cat in perfect health!
I'll definitely be back on my next trip!
Highly recommended! ❤️
Sara was amazing with my cat. I left her with her on a long trip, and she took wonderful care of her, constantly updating me on her and sending me photos and videos. I highly recommend her!
Sara is truly exceptional, I left my dog ​​Milù at this facility and I had a great time 👍 …
I left my cat for 10 days in good hands, photos and videos every day, a wonderful experience, I recommend it to everyone thanks
Sara is a true animal lover. Our furry friends will feel right at home.

Thank you Mrs.Sara for taking such wonderful care of our Fuji while we were away. She took her in even with very little notice & provided us with lots of pictures & updates. She adores animals & you can really tell. Fuji had a great time!!
I left my dog ​​there for four days and found her very well. The lady was kind, punctual, attentive, and precise. I'll be back if needed.
A great experience for our cat, who spent ten peaceful days thanks to Sara's care and attention.

I left my cat at this boarding house for a week and couldn't have chosen a better place. The lady was kind, knowledgeable, and truly affectionate with my cat, who is usually quite shy around strangers.

They updated me every day with photos and messages, which made me feel very reassured. When I picked him up, my cat was calm and in excellent health, a sign that he felt safe and pampered.

I recommend this boarding house to anyone looking for a place for their pet.

For the second year in a row, we left our cat Sole at Mrs. Sara's boarding house for a 7-day stay because we couldn't take him to the beach with us. We were thrilled to see how Sara cared for him with love and professionalism.
We will definitely be using her again in the future. Highly recommended.

A positive experience for our 3-year-old Shila, even though it was her first time at the new kennel! The lady was very kind and caring, constantly updating us with photos and videos! She will definitely be a point of reference and trust!!
Recommended
I left my dog ​​in boarding kennels (for health reasons) for almost 4 months and he was loved and pampered like at home and for this I thank Sara with all my heart
Helpful and kind! She knew how to take care of our dog Prince and make him feel at home!
We left our cat at the boarding house for two weeks. It's a safe, family-friendly environment. I highly recommend it.
Positive experience with our two cats, whom we had to leave for about 7 days. Mrs. Sara was very kind and helpful.
AND LEAVING CATS IN A BOX IS REALLY DANGEROUS THERE ARE 10 CATS IN THE MIDDLE OF THE STREET AND THEY RISK DYING
I don't recommend it
It was a positive experience for my cat Pablo. Thanks to Mrs. Sara, who is very good and often sent me photos to show me how he was doing.

It was a positive experience for our cat, even though it was her first time and she's very foreign! The lady is very affectionate and kept us updated with photos and videos! It was crucial for us to not miss her! Highly recommended.

A week ago, we had to leave and urgently needed a cattery since our kitten couldn't travel with us. Luckily, we found this cattery run by Mrs. Sara, who took complete care of our furry little girl and updated us daily on the situation, sending us photos and videos that were incredibly reassuring. I highly recommend this cattery and thank Mrs. Sara from the bottom of my heart for the way she took care of our kitten.

Sara is a wonderful person, kind and helpful. I contacted her for a work emergency and—even at the last minute—she was able to help me. I should point out that I have two dogs, one of which is a three-legged one, so it was a real challenge. Yet she handled everything seamlessly. During the puppies' stay, she kept me updated with messages and videos, making me feel at ease. I highly recommend her.

The lady is incredibly kind and friendly, but above all, she has managed to ensure our cat, who is staying with her, has a calm and welcoming atmosphere, so much so that he doesn't feel at all disconnected from his usual place of residence. …

Highly recommended home boarding. I have an adult dog that I recently took in from a shelter, and it was the first time I'd had to leave him. They were immediately very helpful and constantly sent me videos and photos of walks and inside the house during my stay. Highly recommended!
This was our first time leaving our cat, and Sara was kind and very attentive. We received photos and updates every day. Highly recommended!

This is the first time I've taken my bulldog to Sara, and I'll bring him back on my next trip. I had a great time; she pampered my dog ​​and took care of him right away. She sent me videos and photos of all the walks she took him on every …
Our Lilly had a great time, and Sara sent us tons of photos and updates during her stay. We recommend this homely guesthouse to everyone!

I took my poodle for a weekend. It was the first time I'd had to leave him behind in 4 years!!! Sara was so sweet and attentive, sending me photos and videos, calming my worries. I'm bringing him back this weekend too. Thanks Sara and Gabriele
